name: CSG and Inter-object Intersection
definition: Performs general Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) by voxelizing each object in a separate slicemap, rendering one over the other with blending for the desired boolean operation.
summary: CSG and Inter-object Intersection performs boolean operations on multiple objects by rasterizing them into slicemaps and blending via GPU logical operations, differing from single-object voxelization and SDF methods by operating in image space.
